this is the most insane thing in ai that's happened all week - and that's saying something. 

in this video i walk through the announcement, the vortex, and a plain-English explanation from GPT-6 Astra. then I give my take on what this could mean for AI and scientific discovery.

subscribe for more videos about AI from an Aussie dude with a mo:

https://www.youtube.com/@LennoxSaint?sub_confirmation=1
